Write a COBOL program (GnuCOBOL) for the "Game of 15".

Rules: Two players alternate picking a number from {1, 2, ..., 9}. A number cannot be picked twice. A player wins when any three of their chosen numbers sum to exactly 15. If all nine numbers are picked and no player has won, the game is a draw.

The program should enumerate every possible game (every legal sequence of moves to completion) and report:

Player 1 wins (player who picks first)
Player 2 wins
Draws
Total games

write_file〈〉{"path": "/Users/mathieuacher/SANDBOX/vibes-test/game15.cbl", "content": "IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. GAME15.
AUTHOR. Generated by Mistral Vibe.

DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01  COUNTERS.
    05  P1-WINS      PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.
    05  P2-WINS      PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.
    05  DRAWS        PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.
    05  TOTAL-GAMES  PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.

01  PERMUTATION.
    05  NUM          PIC 9(2) OCCURS 9 TIMES.

01  HANDS.
    05  P1-HAND.
        10  P1-NUM   PIC 9(2) OCCURS 5 TIMES VALUE 0.
    05  P2-HAND.
        10  P2-NUM   PIC 9(2) OCCURS 4 TIMES VALUE 0.

01  GAME-STATE.
    05  P1-COUNT     PIC 9(2) VALUE 0.
    05  P2-COUNT     PIC 9(2) VALUE 0.
    05  GAME-ENDED   PIC X VALUE 'N'.
        88  END-OF-GAME VALUE 'Y'.

01  WINNING-TRIPLES.
    05  TRIPLE       OCCURS 8 TIMES.
        10  T-NUM    PIC 9(2) OCCURS 3 TIMES.

01  WORK-VARS.
    05  I            PIC 9(2).
    05  J            PIC 9(2).
    05  K            PIC 9(2).
    05  MOVE-NO      PIC 9(2).
    05  CURR-NUM     PIC 9(2).
    05  FOUND        PIC X VALUE 'N'.
        88  FOUND-YES VALUE 'Y'.
    05  HAS-NUM      PIC X VALUE 'N'.
        88  NUM-FOUND VALUE 'Y'.
    05  TEMP         PIC 9(2).
    05  REMAINDER    PIC 9(2).
    05  PERM-DONE    PIC X VALUE 'N'.
        88  ALL-PERMS-DONE VALUE 'Y'.

01  PERM-GEN.
    05  K1           PIC 9(2).
    05  K2           PIC 9(2).
    05  SWAP-TEMP    PIC 9(2).
    05  START-IDX    PIC 9(2).
    05  END-IDX      PIC 9(2).

PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN-LOGIC.
    *> Initialize winning triples
    PERFORM INIT-TRIPLES

    *> Initialize first permutation: 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9
    PERFORM INIT-FIRST-PERM

    *> Process all permutations
    PERFORM PROCESS-CURRENT-PERM
    PERFORM UNTIL ALL-PERMS-DONE
        PERFORM NEXT-PERMUTATION
        IF NOT ALL-PERMS-DONE
            PERFORM PROCESS-CURRENT-PERM
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM

    *> Display results
    PERFORM DISPLAY-RESULTS
    STOP RUN.

INIT-TRIPLES.
    *> Define all winning combinations that sum to 15
    *> 1: 1,5,9
    MOVE 1 TO TRIPLE(1,1)
    MOVE 5 TO TRIPLE(1,2)
    MOVE 9 TO TRIPLE(1,3)
    *> 2: 1,6,8
    MOVE 1 TO TRIPLE(2,1)
    MOVE 6 TO TRIPLE(2,2)
    MOVE 8 TO TRIPLE(2,3)
    *> 3: 2,4,9
    MOVE 2 TO TRIPLE(3,1)
    MOVE 4 TO TRIPLE(3,2)
    MOVE 9 TO TRIPLE(3,3)
    *> 4: 2,5,8
    MOVE 2 TO TRIPLE(4,1)
    MOVE 5 TO TRIPLE(4,2)
    MOVE 8 TO TRIPLE(4,3)
    *> 5: 2,6,7
    MOVE 2 TO TRIPLE(5,1)
    MOVE 6 TO TRIPLE(5,2)
    MOVE 7 TO TRIPLE(5,3)
    *> 6: 3,4,8
    MOVE 3 TO TRIPLE(6,1)
    MOVE 4 TO TRIPLE(6,2)
    MOVE 8 TO TRIPLE(6,3)
    *> 7: 3,5,7
    MOVE 3 TO TRIPLE(7,1)
    MOVE 5 TO TRIPLE(7,2)
    MOVE 7 TO TRIPLE(7,3)
    *> 8: 4,5,6
    MOVE 4 TO TRIPLE(8,1)
    MOVE 5 TO TRIPLE(8,2)
    MOVE 6 TO TRIPLE(8,3).

INIT-FIRST-PERM.
    MOVE 1 TO NUM(1)
    MOVE 2 TO NUM(2)
    MOVE 3 TO NUM(3)
    MOVE 4 TO NUM(4)
    MOVE 5 TO NUM(5)
    MOVE 6 TO NUM(6)
    MOVE 7 TO NUM(7)
    MOVE 8 TO NUM(8)
    MOVE 9 TO NUM(9).

PROCESS-CURRENT-PERM.
    ADD 1 TO TOTAL-GAMES
    MOVE 0 TO P1-COUNT P2-COUNT
    MOVE 'N' TO GAME-ENDED

    PERFORM VARYING MOVE-NO FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL MOVE-NO > 9 OR END-OF-GAME
        MOVE NUM(MOVE-NO) TO CURR-NUM

        *> Check if move is odd (Player 1) or even (Player 2)
        MOVE MOVE-NO TO TEMP
        DIVIDE 2 INTO TEMP GIVING TEMP REMAINDER REMAINDER
        IF REMAINDER = 1
            *> Player 1's turn (moves 1,3,5,7,9)
            ADD 1 TO P1-COUNT
            MOVE CURR-NUM TO P1-NUM(P1-COUNT)
            PERFORM CHECK-WIN-FOR-P1
            IF FOUND-YES
                ADD 1 TO P1-WINS
                SET END-OF-GAME TO TRUE
            END-IF
        ELSE
            *> Player 2's turn (moves 2,4,6,8)
            ADD 1 TO P2-COUNT
            MOVE CURR-NUM TO P2-NUM(P2-COUNT)
            PERFORM CHECK-WIN-FOR-P2
            IF FOUND-YES
                ADD 1 TO P2-WINS
                SET END-OF-GAME TO TRUE
            END-IF
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM

    IF NOT END-OF-GAME
        ADD 1 TO DRAWS
    END-IF.

CHECK-WIN-FOR-P1.
    MOVE 'N' TO FOUND
    IF P1-COUNT >= 3
        PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 8 OR FOUND-YES
            PERFORM CHECK-TRIPLE-FOR-P1
        END-PERFORM
    END-IF.

CHECK-WIN-FOR-P2.
    MOVE 'N' TO FOUND
    IF P2-COUNT >= 3
        PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 8 OR FOUND-YES
            PERFORM CHECK-TRIPLE-FOR-P2
        END-PERFORM
    END-IF.

CHECK-TRIPLE-FOR-P1.
    MOVE 'Y' TO FOUND
    PERFORM VARYING J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL J > 3
        MOVE 'N' TO HAS-NUM
        PERFORM VARYING K FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL K > P1-COUNT OR NUM-FOUND
            IF P1-NUM(K) = TRIPLE(I,J)
                SET NUM-FOUND TO TRUE
            END-IF
        END-PERFORM
        IF NOT NUM-FOUND
            MOVE 'N' TO FOUND
            EXIT PERFORM
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

CHECK-TRIPLE-FOR-P2.
    MOVE 'Y' TO FOUND
    PERFORM VARYING J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL J > 3
        MOVE 'N' TO HAS-NUM
        PERFORM VARYING K FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL K > P2-COUNT OR NUM-FOUND
            IF P2-NUM(K) = TRIPLE(I,J)
                SET NUM-FOUND TO TRUE
            END-IF
        END-PERFORM
        IF NOT NUM-FOUND
            MOVE 'N' TO FOUND
            EXIT PERFORM
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

NEXT-PERMUTATION.
    MOVE 'N' TO PERM-DONE

    *> Find largest k such that NUM(k) < NUM(k+1)
    MOVE 0 TO K1
    PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 8
        IF NUM(I) < NUM(I + 1)
            MOVE I TO K1
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM

    IF K1 = 0
        *> No more permutations
        SET ALL-PERMS-DONE TO TRUE
        EXIT PARAGRAPH
    END-IF

    *> Find largest l > k such that NUM(k) < NUM(l)
    MOVE 0 TO K2
    PERFORM VARYING I FROM K1 + 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 9
        IF NUM(I) > NUM(K1)
            MOVE I TO K2
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM

    *> Swap NUM(k1) and NUM(k2)
    MOVE NUM(K1) TO SWAP-TEMP
    MOVE NUM(K2) TO NUM(K1)
    MOVE SWAP-TEMP TO NUM(K2)

    *> Reverse from k1+1 to end
    MOVE K1 + 1 TO START-IDX
    MOVE 9 TO END-IDX
    PERFORM UNTIL START-IDX >= END-IDX
        MOVE NUM(START-IDX) TO SWAP-TEMP
        MOVE NUM(END-IDX) TO NUM(START-IDX)
        MOVE SWAP-TEMP TO NUM(END-IDX)
        ADD 1 TO START-IDX
        SUBTRACT 1 FROM END-IDX
    END-PERFORM.

DISPLAY-RESULTS.
    DISPLAY " "
    DISPLAY "Game of 15 - All possible games enumeration"
    DISPLAY "=========================================="
    DISPLAY "Total games:    " TOTAL-GAMES
    DISPLAY "Player 1 wins:  " P1-WINS
    DISPLAY "Player 2 wins:  " P2-WINS
    DISPLAY "Draws:          " DRAWS
    DISPLAY " "
    COMPUTE TEMP = P1-WINS + P2-WINS + DRAWS
    DISPLAY "Verification:   " P1-WINS " + " P2-WINS " + " DRAWS " = " TEMP.
"}

The user wants a COBOL program that enumerates every possible game of "Game of 15" and reports the outcomes. Let me understand the problem:

- Two players alternate picking numbers from 1-9
- No number can be picked twice
- A player wins when any three of their chosen numbers sum to exactly 15
- If all nine numbers are picked and no one wins, it's a draw
- Need to enumerate all possible sequences and count wins for P1, P2, and draws

First, let me think about the winning combinations. In the game of 15, the classic winning triples from 1-9 that sum to 15 are:
- 1, 5, 9
- 1, 6, 8
- 2, 4, 9
- 2, 5, 8
- 2, 6, 7
- 3, 4, 8
- 3, 5, 7
- 4, 5, 6

So there are 8 winning combinations.

Now, for the COBOL program. This is a combinatorial enumeration problem. We need to:
1. Generate all permutations of the 9 numbers (9! = 362880 possible sequences)
2. For each sequence, simulate the game:
   - Alternate assigning numbers to P1 and P2
   - After each move, check if the current player has any winning combination
   - If a player wins, count it and stop that game
   - If all 9 moves are made without a winner, count as draw

In COBOL, we'll need:
- A way to represent the sequence of moves
- A way to check for winning combinations
- Counters for P1 wins, P2 wins, draws, total

Since this is a complete enumeration, we can use nested loops or a recursive approach. In COBOL, nested loops for 9 levels would be impractical to write manually. Instead, we can use a recursive approach or generate permutations algorithmically.

For GnuCOBOL, we can use a recursive permutation generation approach. But COBOL doesn't have native recursion support in all dialects. However, GnuCOBOL does support recursive calls.

Alternatively, we can use an iterative approach with Heap's algorithm for generating permutations.

Let me design the program:

1. Initialize counters: P1-wins, P2-wins, draws, total
2. Generate all permutations of numbers 1-9
3. For each permutation:
   - Initialize player hands (P1 and P2)
   - For each number in the permutation (move 1 to 9):
     - Assign to P1 if odd move, P2 if even move
     - Add to that player's hand
     - Check if that player has any winning combination
     - If yes: increment appropriate counter, break to next permutation
   - If no winner after 9 moves: increment draw counter
4. Print results

For efficiency, we should check for wins as soon as a player has at least 3 numbers.

- We need arrays for P1's numbers and P2's numbers
- We need a way to check winning combinations

We'll use Heap's algorithm to generate permutations. Heap's algorithm is an efficient way to generate all permutations of a sequence.

Heap's algorithm (non-recursive version):
```
procedure generate(n : integer, A : array of any):
    var i : integer
    if n = 1 then
        output(A)
    else
        for i := 0; i < n - 1; i += 1 do
            generate(n - 1, A)
            if n is even then
                swap(A[i], A[n-1])
            else
                swap(A[0], A[n-1])
            end if
        end for
        generate(n - 1, A)
    end if
```

The algorithm for next permutation:
1. Find the largest index k such that a[k] < a[k + 1]. If no such index exists, the permutation is the last permutation.

3. Use a different structure

Let me try option 1 - flatten the winning triples into a 1D array of 24 elements (8 triples × 3 numbers each), and calculate the index manually.

Or better yet, I can define 8 separate variables for each triple, but that's messy.

Actually, the standard COBOL way is to define the table properly. Let me check the syntax again. In COBOL, a 2D table should be defined as:

```cobol
01  WINNING-TRIPLES.
    05  TRIPLE OCCURS 8 TIMES.
        10 T-NUM OCCURS 3 TIMES PIC 9(2).
```

And then access it as `TRIPLE(I, J)` or `T-NUM(I, J)` - but the error suggests this isn't working.

```cobol

    05  T-NUM PIC 9(2) OCCURS 24 TIMES.
```

Then TRIPLE(i,j) becomes T-NUM((i-1)*3 + j)

       CHECK-TRIPLE-6-FOR-P1.
           MOVE 'N' TO HAS-N1 HAS-N2 HAS-N3
           PERFORM VARYING K FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL K > P1-COUNT

               IF P1-NUM(K) = WIN6N2 SET HAS-NUM2 TO TRUE

       CHECK-TRIPLE-4-FOR-P2.

           ELSE

       CHECK-TRIPLE-5-FOR-P2.
           MOVE 'N' TO HAS-N1 HAS-N2 HAS-N3
           PERFORM VARYING K FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL K > P2-COUNT
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN5N1 SET HAS-NUM1 TO TRUE
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN5N2 SET HAS-NUM2 TO TRUE

       CHECK-TRIPLE-6-FOR-P2.
           MOVE 'N' TO HAS-N1 HAS-N2 HAS-N3

           END-PERFORM
           IF HAS-NUM1 AND HAS-NUM2 AND HAS-NUM3

           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO FOUND
           END-IF.

       CHECK-TRIPLE-7-FOR-P2.
           MOVE 'N' TO HAS-N1 HAS-N2 HAS-N3
           PERFORM VARYING K FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL K > P2-COUNT
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN7N1 SET HAS-NUM1 TO TRUE
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN7N2 SET HAS-NUM2 TO TRUE
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN7N3 SET HAS-NUM3 TO TRUE
           END-PERFORM
           IF HAS-NUM1 AND HAS-NUM2 AND HAS-NUM3
               MOVE 'Y' TO FOUND
           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO FOUND
           END-IF.

       CHECK-TRIPLE-8-FOR-P2.
           MOVE 'N' TO HAS-N1 HAS-N2 HAS-N3
           PERFORM VARYING K FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL K > P2-COUNT
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN8N1 SET HAS-NUM1 TO TRUE
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN8N2 SET HAS-NUM2 TO TRUE
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN8N3 SET HAS-NUM3 TO TRUE
           END-PERFORM
           IF HAS-NUM1 AND HAS-NUM2 AND HAS-NUM3
               MOVE 'Y' TO FOUND
           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO FOUND
           END-IF.

       NEXT-PERMUTATION.

           MOVE 0 TO K1
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 8
               IF NUM(I) < NUM(I + 1)
                   MOVE I TO K1
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM

           IF K1 = 0
               SET ALL-PERMS-DONE TO TRUE
               EXIT PARAGRAPH
           END-IF

           MOVE 0 TO K2
           COMPUTE I = K1 + 1
           PERFORM UNTIL I > 9
               IF NUM(I) > NUM(K1)
                   MOVE I TO K2
               END-IF
               ADD 1 TO I
           END-PERFORM

           MOVE NUM(K1) TO SWAP-TEMP
           MOVE NUM(K2) TO NUM(K1)
           MOVE SWAP-TEMP TO NUM(K2)

           COMPUTE START-IDX = K1 + 1
           MOVE 9 TO END-IDX
           PERFORM UNTIL START-IDX >= END-IDX
               MOVE NUM(START-IDX) TO SWAP-TEMP
               MOVE NUM(END-IDX) TO NUM(START-IDX)
               MOVE SWAP-TEMP TO NUM(END-IDX)
               ADD 1 TO START-IDX
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM END-IDX
           END-PERFORM.

       DISPLAY-RESULTS.

           DISPLAY "Game of 15 - All possible games enumeration"
           DISPLAY "=========================================="
           DISPLAY "Total games:    " TOTAL-GAMES
           DISPLAY "Player 1 wins:  " P1-WINS
           DISPLAY "Player 2 wins:  " P2-WINS
           DISPLAY "Draws:          " DRAWS
           DISPLAY " "
           COMPUTE TEMP = P1-WINS + P2-WINS + DRAWS
           DISPLAY "Verification:   " P1-WINS " + " P2-WINS " + " DRAWS = " TEMP
           .
EOF

       CHECK-TRIPLE-6-FOR-P1.

           END-PERFORM
           IF HAS-NUM1 AND HAS-NUM2 AND HAS-NUM3

           END-IF.

       CHECK-TRIPLE-5-FOR-P2.

       CHECK-TRIPLE-6-FOR-P2.

               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN6N2 SET HAS-NUM2 TO TRUE
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN6N3 SET HAS-NUM3 TO TRUE
           END-PERFORM
           IF HAS-NUM1 AND HAS-NUM2 AND HAS-NUM3
               MOVE 'Y' TO P2-WON
           END-IF.

       CHECK-TRIPLE-7-FOR-P2.
           MOVE 'N' TO HAS-N1 HAS-N2 HAS-N3
           PERFORM VARYING K FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL K > P2-COUNT
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN7N1 SET HAS-NUM1 TO TRUE
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN7N2 SET HAS-NUM2 TO TRUE
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN7N3 SET HAS-NUM3 TO TRUE
           END-PERFORM
           IF HAS-NUM1 AND HAS-NUM2 AND HAS-NUM3
               MOVE 'Y' TO P2-WON
           END-IF.

       CHECK-TRIPLE-8-FOR-P2.

           PERFORM VARYING K FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL K > P2-COUNT
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN8N1 SET HAS-NUM1 TO TRUE
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN8N2 SET HAS-NUM2 TO TRUE
               IF P2-NUM(K) = WIN8N3 SET HAS-NUM3 TO TRUE
           END-PERFORM
           IF HAS-NUM1 AND HAS-NUM2 AND HAS-NUM3
               MOVE 'Y' TO P2-WON
           END-IF.

       NEXT-PERMUTATION.
           MOVE 'N' TO ALL-DONE
           MOVE 0 TO K1
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 8
               IF NUM(I) < NUM(I + 1)
                   MOVE I TO K1
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM

           IF K1 = 0
               SET ALL-PERMS-DONE TO TRUE
               EXIT PARAGRAPH
           END-IF

           MOVE 0 TO K2
           COMPUTE I = K1 + 1
           PERFORM UNTIL I > 9
               IF NUM(I) > NUM(K1)
                   MOVE I TO K2
               END-IF
               ADD 1 TO I
           END-PERFORM

           MOVE NUM(K1) TO SWAP-TEMP
           MOVE NUM(K2) TO NUM(K1)
           MOVE SWAP-TEMP TO NUM(K2)

           COMPUTE START-IDX = K1 + 1
           MOVE 9 TO END-IDX
           PERFORM UNTIL START-IDX >= END-IDX
               MOVE NUM(START-IDX) TO SWAP-TEMP
               MOVE NUM(END-IDX) TO NUM(START-IDX)
               MOVE SWAP-TEMP TO NUM(END-IDX)
               ADD 1 TO START-IDX
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM END-IDX
           END-PERFORM.

       DISPLAY-RESULTS.
           DISPLAY " "
           DISPLAY "Game of 15 - All possible games enumeration"
           DISPLAY "=========================================="
           DISPLAY "Total games:    " TOTAL-GAMES
           DISPLAY "Player 1 wins:  " P1-WINS
           DISPLAY "Player 2 wins:  " P2-WINS
           DISPLAY "Draws:          " DRAWS
           DISPLAY " "
           COMPUTE TEMP = P1-WINS + P2-WINS + DRAWS
           DISPLAY "Verification:   " P1-WINS " + " P2-WINS " + " DRAWS = " TEMP
           .
EOF
